preconditions.description: The number of pairs n and the number of colors k must be within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output must either be 'NO' or start with 'YES' followed by n lines of costume colors.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(b) <= k and 1 <= int(g) <= k for b, g in zip(return_value.splitlines()[1:], return_value.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each costume color must be between 1 and k, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(b != g for b, g in zip(return_value.splitlines()[1:], return_value.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: No pair can have the same color for both the man and the woman.

postconditions.expression: all(b1 != b2 and g1 != g2 for (b1, g1), (b2, g2) in zip(zip(return_value.splitlines()[1:], return_value.splitlines()[1:]), zip(return_value.splitlines()[2:], return_value.splitlines()[2:])))
postconditions.description: Consecutive pairs must have different colors for both the man and the woman.

postconditions.expression: all((b1, g1) != (b2, g2) for (b1, g1), (b2, g2) in zip(zip(return_value.splitlines()[1:], return_value.splitlines()[1:]), zip(return_value.splitlines()[1:], return_value.splitlines()[1:])))
postconditions.description: No two pairs can have the same combination of colors.
